title: They're ok
text:
They're ok. There's no price on these currently so I can't comment on value but these seem decently made. I could see paying $15-20 for the set. They come in a nice box but it's kind of hilarious because they had another company's name on it and this "Hotime" just printed a white address label with their name on it and slaps it on the box. Kind of ghetto in my opinion.

SO as far as the quality of them, they're fairly sharp and cut pretty well. We cut veggies, chicken, and beef with them and they cut thru those pretty well. I've had better knives but if these came in at a fair price point then I'd say they're worth it.
